title: PBC — definition, AMA/PDHE2, patterns, prevalence, associations, diagnostic algorithm and presentation
guide: Cardinal intrahepatic cholestasis; autoimmune non-suppurative destruction of small intrahepatic/intralobular ducts, T-cell > B-cell; AMA 95% against PDHE2; hepatic (jaundice) vs cholestatic (fatigue & pruritus → duct destruction → jaundice, poor prognosis); F>M 9:1, 4th–5th decade; Sjogren with arthritis, distal RTA type 1, gallstones; ultrasound → AMA → PBC vs surgery; asymptomatic m/c presentation, fatigue m/c symptom, jaundice 10% late, hypercholesterolemia/xanthelasma, hyperpigmentation, hepatomegaly 30–40%, splenomegaly <15%, steatorrhea → fat malabsorption tree.

title: PBC labs, histology and treatment; PSC definition through laboratory features
guide: Raised ALP, AMA IgM 95%, ANA 50%; canal of Hering loss earliest, ductopenia m/c, florid duct lesion with non-caseating granulomas most characteristic; UDCA slows progression, obeticholic acid = farnesoid receptor agonist. PSC: fibrosing destruction of intra+extra hepatic ducts, IgG4 disease d/t leaky gut; M>F 2nd–3rd decade; HLA B-8, DR-3; fatigue, pruritus, leaky gut, cholestasis; cholangiocarcinoma; UC 2/3rd vs 5%, atypical p-ANCA, pancolitis with rectal sparing, colorectal carcinoma, transplant only; IgG4, atypical p-ANCA, AMA negative.

title: PSC imaging, histology, treatment and the PBC vs PSC table
guide: MRCP (IOC) / ERCP → strictures/ectasia; concentric periductal onion-skin fibrosis; surgery with 25% recurrence; table: perimenopausal female vs young male, autoimmune vs fibrosing, HLA absent vs present, smoking increases risk vs protective, Sjogren vs UC, AMA vs MRCP, UDCA vs transplant, not premalignant vs cholangiocarcinoma.
